resources.string: We need to verify you are a real person for security purposes.
Your face needs to be verified against your information. Please follow the guidelines below to ensure proper capture:
Use a well-lit space with even lighting, avoid very dark or overly bright areas.
Keep your head centered and follow prompts.
Remove any head coverings which may be obstructing your face.
The check flashes a sequence of colours on screen. Take care if you are sensitive to flashing light.
After 5 fails, apply a 30-60 minute timeout.
